tokens_version_restamp: 2.1.0 -> 2.3.0 on 2026-08-04 by /idea-render-mockup. NOT a re-render. Verified: every colour var this render injects matches design-tokens.yaml 2.3.0 in BOTH the light :root block and the prefers-color-scheme:dark block (3400 vars across the 23 re-stamped screens, 0 mismatches). Tokens 2.2.0 and 2.3.0 are additive on the colour and type surfaces a preview consumes. states[].hash was NOT recomputed and is unchanged — this stamp asserts palette currency only, not full input-SHA currency.
sort_order_note: Cards render Active-first then Inactive, matching the ViewModel sort — British Gas / Vodafone / Aviva, then TV Licensing. The summary chips read Active (3) · Inactive (1) off the same list, so the header count and the visible rows cannot disagree.
badge_variant_note: status_variant from demo-data drives the badge: Active → primary-container fill, Inactive → outline. TV Licensing is the only outline row, which is why one Inactive mandate is fixtured rather than zero.
amount_colour_note: Amounts render in on-surface, NOT error. A collected direct debit is a normal outgoing, and colouring it red reads as a failure (ui.yaml dd_previous_amount test_context states this explicitly).
unsupported_vs_empty: unsupported renders the info variant (secondary-container illustration, no CTA); empty renders the neutral variant. They are deliberately distinguishable — OBIE makes the direct-debits resource optional, so a 404 means 'not readable', not 'none exist'. Telling a customer with four live mandates they have none would be a false statement about money leaving their account.
unsupported_body_composition: Body renders demo-data's `message` + `detail` as one paragraph, because uiState.message is a single server-supplied string that the fixture splits for readability. Nothing is added beyond the two verbatim sentences.
error_variant: Renders the 401 TokenExpired variant: body is the fixture's userMessage verbatim and Retry is SHOWN (isRetriable: true). The 403 ConsentRevoked variant hides Retry entirely — retry cannot help when the consent itself was withdrawn; the user must re-authorise. Both are fixtured in demo-data#error_fixtures.
orphans_removed: cancel_confirm.html and populated.html were rendered against an older ui.yaml that declared neither state; ui.yaml#states is [loading, content, empty, unsupported, error].
